H4210: properly, instrumental music; by implication, a poem set to notes
H1732: David, the youngest son of Jesse
H1272: to bolt, i.e. figuratively, to flee suddenly
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H53: Abshalom, a son of David; also (the fuller form) a later Israelite
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H4100: properly, interrogative what? (including how? why? when?); but also exclamation, what! (including how!), or indefinitely what (including whatever, and even relatively, that which); often used with prefixes in various adverbial or conjunctive senses
H7231: properly, to cast together , i.e. increase, especially in number; to multiply by the myriad
H6862: narrow; (as a noun) a tight place (usually figuratively, i.e. trouble); also a pebble ; (transitive) an opponent (as crowding)
H7227: abundant (in quantity, size, age, number, rank, quality)
H6965: to rise (in various applications, literal, figurative, intensive and causative)
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H5315: properly, a breathing creature, i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
H369: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
H3444: something saved, i.e. (abstractly) deliverance; hence, aid, victory, prosperity
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H859: thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you
H4043: a shield (i.e. the small one or buckler); figuratively, a protector; also the scaly hide of the crocodile
H1157: in up to or over against; generally at, beside, among, behind, for, etc.
H3519: properly, weight, but only figuratively in a good sense, splendor or copiousness
H7311: to be high actively, to rise or raise (in various applications, literally or figuratively)
H7218: the head (as most easily shaken), whether literal or figurative (in many applications, of place, time, rank, itc.)
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H7121: to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)
H6030: properly, to eye or (generally) to heed, i.e. pay attention; by implication, to respond; by extension to begin to speak; specifically to sing, shout, testify, announce
H2022: a mountain or range of hills (sometimes used figuratively)
H6944: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract, sanctity
H7901: to lie down (for rest, sexual connection, decease or any other purpose)
H3462: properly, to be slack or languid, i.e. (by implication) sleep (figuratively, to die); also to grow old, stale or inveterate
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H5564: to prop (literally or figuratively); reflexively, to lean upon or take hold of (in a favorable or unfavorable sense)
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H3372: to fear; morally, to revere; caus. to frighten
H7233: abundance (in number), i.e. (specifically) a myriad (whether definite or indefinite)
H5971: a people (as a congregated unit); specifically, a tribe (as those of Israel); hence (collectively) troops or attendants; figuratively, a flock
H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
H5439: (as noun) a circle, neighbour, or environs; but chiefly (as adverb, with or without preposition) around
H7896: to place (in a very wide application)
H3467: properly, to be open, wide or free, i.e. (by implication) to be safe; causatively, to free or succor
H5221: to strike (lightly or severely, literally or figuratively)
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H3605: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
H3895: the cheek (from its fleshiness); hence, the jaw-bone
H8127: a tooth (as sharp); specifically ivory; figuratively, a cliff
H7563: morally wrong; concretely, an (actively) bad person
